Until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel ()... In this prophetic song of Deborah and Barak it treats of the perversion of the truth of the Church, and of its restoration. AE 652:6.
In the song of Deborah and Barak it treats of the combat of truth against falsity, and of the victory of the former. AE 422:18.
